title: Pilot A: the cell-to-cell lifetime floor in the Geslin et al. dynamic-cycling dataset
description: Pre-registered re-analysis of the duplicate-cell pairs in the dynamic-cycling dataset of Geslin et al. (Nature Energy 10, 172-180, 2025): the distribution of the relative lifetime difference between nominally identical cells cycled under the same protocol at 35 C, the per-cell lifetime noise it implies, and the selection-only shortfall of the worst of N identical cells. Predictions were committed before the analysis ran. Code under the MIT licence; results, figure and note under CC BY 4.0. The data are not included; they are available from the authors' repository and the Stanford Digital Repository (CC BY 4.0).
